# pbs_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the privileges a Proxmox Backup Server user or API token has, as PBS works them out from its roles: whether a token can back up to a datastore, say. For an API token, these are what it can actually do — the privileges of its own ACL entries that its user has too. Every user and token may read its own; reading another's needs Sys.Audit on /access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What the Proxmox VE cluster's API token may do on the datastore it backs up
# to: the privileges of the token's own ACL entries that its user has too.
data "pbs_permissions" "pve_on_store1" {
  auth_id = "pve@pbs!cluster1"
  path    = "/datastore/store1"
}

output "pve_can_back_up_to_store1" {
  value = contains(keys(lookup(data.pbs_permissions.pve_on_store1.permissions, "/datastore/store1", {})), "Datastore.Backup")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_id` (String) User ID or API token ID to read the privileges of, such as `alice@pbs!ci`. Leave it out for the user or token the provider signs in as.
- `path` (String) Read the privileges on this path only, such as `/datastore/store1`. Leave it out for every path with an ACL entry that applies.

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Map of Map of Boolean) Privileges by path: for each path, a map from privilege, such as `Datastore.Backup`, to whether it also applies below the path. A path where the user or token has no privilege has an empty map or is missing, so test with `lookup()` or `try()`.
